title: Server estate
pitch: One frame for a whole estate: facts and state on the title line, meters, problems worst first, sites beside them and backups below.
makeItYours: Fill the meters and the attention list from results you already have in memory.
Add a section per area you report on, and mark the long ones Detail so they print below.
Name what the attention list counts with AttentionNoun and AttentionOutOf.
useCase: Use it when one screen has to say how an estate is doing and what to fix first.
